'''Nym Technologies''' is a Swiss company that provides [[internet privacy]] technology utilizing [[Nym (mixnet)|Nym]] [[mix network]] and noise generation networks. Nym offers [[Virtual private network|VPN]] and [[blockchain]]-related software and [[network service]]s. Its most notable service, '''NymVPN''', advertises itself as a [[VPN service]] for privacy and [[Internet security|security]].<ref name="Phillips">{{cite web |url = https://www.tomsguide.com/computing/vpns/introducing-nymvpn-could-this-be-the-worlds-most-secure-vpn |title = Introducing NymVPN – could this be the world's most secure VPN? |last = Phillips |first = George |date = 13 March 2025 |website = Tom's Guide |publisher = |access-date = 2025-12-29 }}</ref><ref name="Osborne">{{cite news |last = Osborne |first = Charlie |title = NymVPN: Introducing a security-first decentralized VPN with a Mixnet flair |newspaper = ZDNet |date = 22 April 2025 |url = https://www.zdnet.com/article/ai-kills-cloud-first-hybrid-computing-comeback/ |access-date = 2026-01-01 }}</ref><ref name="Valiaugaitė">{{cite news |last = Valiaugaitė |first = Inga |title = NymVPN review 2026 |newspaper = Cybernews |date = 4 December 2025 |url = https://cybernews.com/best-vpn/nymvpn-review/ }}</ref>

Nym Technologies was formed in [[Neuchâtel]], Switzerland in 2018.<ref name="Brühl"/> NymVPN was in [[Software release life cycle|development]] and [[Software_testing|testing]] for several years,<ref name="Ehrlich">{{cite news |last = Ehrlich |first = Steve |title = Your VPN May Not Be Private. This Blockchain Startup Nym Has A Fix |newspaper = Forbes |date = 22 October 2024 |url = https://www.forbes.com/sites/stevenehrlich/2024/10/22/your-vpn-may-not-be-private-blockchain-startup-nym-aims-to-cure-this/ |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref><ref name="Piotrowska HOPE">{{cite web |url = https://xiii.hope.net/hope2020/speaker/7DUQLY/ |title = Resistance to NSA-Level Global Adversaries With the Nym MixNet |last = Piotrowska |first = Ania |date = 2020 |website = HOPE 2020 |access-date = 2025-12-30}}</ref> with the public release in March 2025. It is [[Cross-platform software|cross-platform]], [[Free software|free]] and [[Open-source software|open source]] software ([[Free and open-source software|FOSS]]). Developed by [[computer security]] researchers, it was presented at [[Computer security conference|conferences]] such as [[Chaos Communication Congress]],<ref name="Brühl">{{cite news |last = Brühl |first = Jannis |title = Harry Halpin hat einen Plan für das Internet |newspaper = Süddeutsche Zeitung |location = Munich |language = de |date = 25 February 2022 |url = https://www.sueddeutsche.de/wirtschaft/verschluesselung-harry-halpin-hat-einen-plan-fuer-das-internet-1.5535968 |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref> [[Hackers on Planet Earth|HOPE]],<ref name="Halpin HOPE">{{cite web |url = https://schedule.hope.net/hope16/talk/UNCXDB/ |title = NymVPN: The First Real-World Decentralized Noise-Generating Mixnet for Anonymity |last = Halpin |first = Harry |date = 2025 |website = HOPE_16 |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref> and at the [[Free Software Foundation]]'s [[LibrePlanet]]<ref name="Ghappour Libre">{{cite web |url = https://media.libreplanet.org/u/libreplanet/m/the-nym-mixnet-free-software-to-end-mass-surveillance/ |title = The Nym mixnet: Free software to end mass surveillance |last = Ghappour |first = Ahmed |date = 2023 |website = LibrePlanet 2023 |publisher = Free Software Foundation |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref> during its alpha-beta development and after its public release. The Nym mixnet technology was also tested at some of these events. NymVPN has undergone [[Information security audit|security audit]]s<ref name="audits">{{cite web |url = https://nym.com/trust-center/independently-audited |title = Independently Audited |date = 2025 |publisher = Nym Technologies |access-date = 2026-01-09 }}</ref><ref name="2023-24">{{cite web |url = https://nym.com/blog/Nym-security-audits-2023-2024 |title = Security audits of the Nym network and apps 2023–2024 |last = Piotrowska |first = Ania M. |date = 4 February 2025 |publisher = Nym Technologies |access-date = 2026-01-09 }}</ref> by JP Aumasson (2021),<ref name="Aumasson">{{cite web |url = https://nym.com/nym-audit-report-draft-202109-3.pdf |title = Nym Security Review |last = Aumasson |first = JP |date = 13 September 2021 |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref> Oak Security (2023),<ref name="Oak">{{cite web |url = https://github.com/oak-security/audit-reports/blob/main/Nym/2023-03-27%20Audit%20Report%20-%20Nym%20Mixnet%20and%20Vesting%20Contracts%20v1.0.pdf |title = Audit Report: Nym Mixnet and Vesting Contracts |date = 27 March 2023 |publisher = Oak Security |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref> [[Cure53]] (2024),<ref name="Cure53">{{cite web |url = https://cure53.de/audit-report_nym.pdf |title = Audit-Report Nym Mobile & Desktop, VPN, Infra & Cryptography 07.2024 |last1 = Heiderich |first1 = Mario |last2 = Pirker |first2 = Alexander |last3 = Bleichenbacher |first3 = Daniel |author-link3 = Daniel Bleichenbacher |last4 = Herrera |first4 = Luan |last5 = Conde |first5 = Marta |last6 = Kobeissi |first6 = Nadim |author-link6 = Nadim Kobeissi |date = 4 November 2025 |publisher = Cure53 |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref> and Cryspen. Nym Wallet has also been independently audited (2023).<ref name="Oak Wallet">{{cite web |url = https://github.com/oak-security/audit-reports/blob/main/Nym/Audit%20Report%20-%20Nym%20Wallet.pdf |title = Audit Report: Nym Wallet |date = 2 June 2023 |publisher = Oak Security |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref> 

NymVPN operates separate entry and exit nodes using the AmneziaWG implementation of the [[WireGuard]] protocol on its "fast" connection mode and five-hop mixnet on "anonymous" mode and maintains [[Zero-knowledge service|no logs]]. It supports a [[command-line interface]], [[split tunneling]], custom entry and exit [[Node (networking)|node]] selection, an internet connection kill switch, zero-knowledge credentials and payments, diskless architecture, [[IPv6]] with leak protection, customizable [[Domain Name System|DNS]] servers, DNS leak protection, perfect [[forward secrecy]], [[QUIC]], and [[SOCKS|SOCKS5]], and the app's user interface is available in multiple languages. It is written in [[Rust (programming language)|Rust]].<ref name="NymVPN Client GitHub">{{cite web |url = https://github.com/nymtech/nym-vpn-client |title = NymVPN Client |website = GitHub |publisher = Nym Tech |access-date = 2026-01-01}}</ref> Nym announced that it will launch a public [[bug bounty program]] to incentivize [[Vulnerability (computer security)|vulnerability]] investigation and reporting. 

NymVPN payments are accepted in various [[Cryptocurrency|cryptocurrencies]]. Nym Technologies offers a [[Cryptocurrency wallet|crypto wallet]], and it incentivizes volunteers running nodes with payments in its '''NYM''' token.<ref name="Valiaugaitė"/> 

As of January 2026 the Nym Technologies [[advisory board]] consists of [[George Danezis]], [[Aggelos Kiayias]], [[Ben Laurie]], and [[Bart Preneel]]. Additional advisors include [[Daniel J. Bernstein]], [[Chelsea Manning]], Karthikeyan Bhargavan, and [[Carmela Troncoso]].<ref name="Nym about">{{cite web |url = https://nym.com/about |title = The Nym Team |date = 2025 |publisher = Nym Technologies |access-date = 2025-12-03 }}</ref> Nym partners with academic organizations such as the Security and Privacy Engineering Laboratory (SPRING) at [[École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne]] (EPFL), the Computer Security and Industrial Cryptography (COSIC) research group at [[KU Leuven]], and Cryspen.<ref name="NymVPN Client GitHub"/>

Alternative services in the security and privacy focused VPN market include [[Mullvad]], [[Proton VPN]], [[IVPN]], and ultimately [[Tor (network)|Tor]] VPN when it comes out of beta development and testing. NymVPN exceeds VPN service guidelines recommended by the [[Electronic Frontier Foundation]] (EFF)<ref name="EFF">{{cite web |url = https://ssd.eff.org/module/choosing-vpn-thats-right-you |title = Choosing the VPN That's Right for You |date = 24 January 2025 |website = Surveillance Self-Defense |publisher = Electronic Frontier Foundation |access-date = 2026-01-06}}</ref> and the [[Freedom of the Press Foundation]].<ref name="Huerta">{{cite web |url = https://freedom.press/digisec/blog/choosing-a-vpn/ |title = An in-depth guide to choosing a VPN |last = Huerta |first = David |orig-date = 29 June 2018 |date = 18 January 2025 |publisher = Freedom of the Press Foundation |access-date = 2026-01-06}}</ref>

Disadvantages of the mixnet method include increased bandwidth and server load with consequently greater [[IT energy management|energy usage]].<ref name="Volpicelli">{{cite news |last = Volpicelli |first = Gian M. |title = This startup is working to bring full anonymity to the internet |newspaper = Wired |date = 12 June 2020 |url = https://www.wired.com/story/nym-privacy-anonymity-internet/ |access-date = 2025-12-30 }}</ref> Although connection [[Network throughput|speeds]] have increased significantly, there are noticeable [[Network delay|latency]] issues that aren't easily fully resolved and can impact certain users.<ref name="Valiaugaitė"/> Unlike some other VPN providers, Nym Tech has not announced specific plans to address [[post-quantum cryptography]] but has said it is working on the issue and intends to not rush an implementation prematurely.<ref name="futureproofing">{{cite web |url = https://nymcom.vercel.app/blog/nym-post-quantum-roadmap |title = Future-proofing privacy: Nym's roadmap to post-quantum security |last = Piowtrowska |first = Ania M. |date = 4 April 2025 |publisher = Nym Technologies |access-date = 2026-01-06 }}</ref> Mixnet compute paths and nodes could potentially be compromised.<ref name="Oldenburg">{{Cite journal |last1 = Oldenburg |first1 = Lennart |last2 = Juarez |first2 = Marc |last3 = Rúa |first3 = Enrique Argones |last4 = Diaz |first4 = Claudia |date = 2024 |title = MixMatch: Flow Matching for Mixnet Traffic |url = https://petsymposium.org/popets/2024/popets-2024-0050.php |journal = Proceedings on Privacy Enhancing Technologies |issue=2 |pages = 276–294 |doi=10.56553/popets-2024-0050 |doi-access=free }}</ref><ref name="Xinshu Ma">{{Cite web |author-link=Xinshu Ma |author-link2 = Florentin Rochet |author-link3 = Tariq Elahi |title=Stopping Silent Sneaks: Defending against Malicious Mixes with Topological Engineering |url=https://bpb-eu-w2.wpmucdn.com/blogs.bristol.ac.uk/dist/1/670/files/2022/12/Stopping-Silent-Sneaks-Defending-against-Malicious-Mixes-with-Topological-Engineering.pdf}}</ref> NymVPN specifically and mixnets generally are also [[emerging technologies]] with shorter windows of time that have undergone testing, and at lesser scale, although Nym undergoes security reviews and is FOSS.
